desc: Derive the interval-transition rule for expanding a set of reachable safe positions across a long unobstructed segment.
Determine how to process each forbidden interval, including whether it can be jumped over using a jump of length at most B.
Prove that maintaining only boundary information for reachable positions is sufficient despite gaps caused by early jumps.
Design an O(M · B) or similarly efficient implementation suitable for N ≤ 10^12.
Check edge cases: no bad intervals, an obstacle too wide to cross, unreachable initial positions, and reaching exactly square N.
Develop and prove an accelerated B-bit finite-state DP for long good runs, covering both A=B and A<B.
